name: com.mindattic.capture
description: Record gameplay and take screenshots from code or the command line. Run a player with -capture video to film from start to exit at native resolution, or -capture screen 5 for a PNG every 5 seconds. Game events (CaptureUnity.Raise("critical-hit")) trigger screenshots, clips and replays through capture.json rules. Output goes to R:\MindAttic\Capture\<repo>\<timestamp>.<ext>. Production builds ignore it (use MindAttic > Capture > Build Windows Player (Capture Enabled)). Windows editor and Windows players; needs ffmpeg on PATH.
